report.explanation: Current telemetry contradicts the operator hypothesis: all sampled checkout traces return HTTP 200 across order, inventory, payment, and postgres save_order, and order metrics show 21.3 successful /v1/orders 200 responses with zero 502s. The deployment record shows only baseline order v1.0.0 with no prior version, so it cannot establish a deployment-caused fault. No bounded root cause is supported; hand off.
missing_evidence: Error/failure traces or logs showing non-200 checkout responses during the incident window
Order service logs (excluded evidence ev-68757353a5d2590b-r0-order-logs) to confirm or refute error presence
Gateway logs (excluded evidence ev-68757353a5d2590b-r0-gateway-logs) for upstream error status
Deployment history showing a version change preceding the alleged errors
Time-series metrics over the incident window rather than a single 60s snapshot
